channel.title: Antiques Roadshow
channel.desc: The Victoria and Albert Museum in London is the venue for people to bring along their antiques and have them examined. Among the items are a collection of Japanese hair decorations, a necklace whose beads once adorned Egyptian mummies, a selection of letters written by Lewis Carroll, and a silver-plated dish dated from the Arts and Crafts movement. Michael Aspel presents.
